Curious about a role where you can make a real difference to production planning? As our End-to-End Planner, you will connect Operations, Procurement and Commercial—turning complex supply challenges into clear plans and informed decisions.

**The role

**You will own operational and tactical planning for relevant production lines, help balancing production, purchasing, inventory and customer needs. You will also contribute to a stronger, globally consistent planning processes.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Managing the full planning horizon in SAP ePPDS, from operational to tactical levels, including placing purchase orders with suppliers

• Maintaining and acting on SAP exception reports daily, managing process orders and due dates, and addressing risks to order fulfillment and stock levels in the monthly S&OP process

• Planning specific production lines in Frederikssund while ensuring alignment with global operations. Develop and maintain production plans while keeping a global overview.

• Owning the monthly Sales & Operations (S&OP) supply reviews for your lines, presenting data-driven insights, imbalances and trade-off scenarios

• Optimizing inventory and safety-stock levels, and support continuous improvement of planning processes

After your first year, success will mean that production lines have clear plans for order volumes and start/end dates. Decision-makers can make aligned, fact-based decisions, and risks to order fulfilment or inventory are identified, escalated and addressed in time.

**What You Bring

**We expect that you have some years of practical experience with integrated supply chain planning, ideally in process industry or a technology-service environment. You have obtained knowledge of the S&OP cycle and supply planning for finished goods and/or raw materials, probably in a production environment.

Strong proficiency in SAP ePPDS, APS solutions, Business Warehouse, Excel and PowerPoint.

As a person you have a structured, analytical approach, you pay attention to detail and have the ability to turn complex data into clear decision-making material. You succeed in your stakeholder management because of your strong communication and collaboration skills and the confidence to work across functions.

On the more formal side, you hold a relevant academic technical engineering, Supply Chain Management or Economics degree.

Fluency in written and spoken English, as well as Danish, is a prerequisite.

The role requires physic presence in Lyngby and Frederikssund.

**Why join us

**You will have a hands-on role with a broad view of the planning process—from daily operational decisions to tactical supply planning. Your analyses and recommendations will help balance production, purchasing, inventory and customer delivery needs.

At Topsoe, we are united by a shared purpose: helping our customers and partners accelerate the energy transition. You will join a company built on innovation, collaboration, and a commitment to solving some of the world's most important challenges.

**Your new team

**You will be a part of a team of 9 who work closely with colleagues across Operations, Procurement, Commercial and other relevant functions, as well as stakeholders at the production site in Frederikssund. Together, you will surface planning challenges early, align on priorities and support decisions that keep production and supply plans on track.

**How To Apply

**If you would like to be part of a global company that combines technology leadership with meaningful impact, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your application and CV in English. For questions regarding the position, please contact Jesper Koch Olsen, JKOL@topsoe.com.

Application deadline: November 11, 2026.

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.

To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.

_To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. We kindly request that you refrain from reaching out to us regarding potential candidates. Thank you for your understanding.

_**About Us

**Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.

Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals.

We offer world-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air.

We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, serving customers all around the globe. To learn more, visit www.topsoe.com.

**The Impact You'll Make

**At Danfoss Climate Solutions, we are driving the transition toward more sustainable and energy-efficient solutions. As our Global Inventory Manager (m/f/d), you will ensure the right products are available at the right time across our global network, balancing customer service, working capital, and operational efficiency.

Working within a global supply chain organization, you will take ownership of inventory strategy and performance across regions and sites. Through data-driven decision-making, process standardization, and cross-functional collaboration, you will help optimize inventory, support business growth, and strengthen supply chain performance.

As part of a business experiencing significant global expansion, you will have the opportunity to shape best practices, drive continuous improvement, and make a visible impact on our customers and our business.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Own and drive the global inventory strategy, performance management, and inventory optimization agenda across regions and sites.

• Monitor inventory performance, identify improvement opportunities, and implement actions that balance service levels, inventory investment, and cost.

• Standardize inventory processes, develop data-driven reporting, and lead cross-functional initiatives that strengthen global supply chain performance.

• Develop and enhance reporting tools and dashboards (Excel, Power BI) to support data-driven decision-making and inventory optimization.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Experience in inventory management within a multinational, multi-site manufacturing or supply chain environment.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, influence stakeholders, and drive results in a global matrix organization.

• Strong analytical and business acumen, including the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights using tools such as Excel and Power BI.

• Experience working with S&OP/SIOP planning processes; knowledge of Integrated Business Planning (IBP) is an advantage.

• A proactive, structured, and self-driven approach with the ability to thrive in a fast-growing and evolving global environment.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Product Engineer, Hørsholm

**General information

**Location: Denmark, Force Technology - Hørsholm

You will play a key role in making new products ready for production, contributing to the manufacture and testing of prototypes, and ensuring that experience from production, suppliers and customers is translated into specific product improvements.

As part of the development team, you will work closely with developers, technicians, production teams, PCB suppliers and product specialists to ensure products can be produced, tested, documented and supported efficiently.

Your responsibilities will include prototype assembly and testing, preparing PCB test procedures, and maintaining PCB, design and production documentation to support product release and continuous improvement. In collaboration with PCB suppliers and product specialists, you will also contribute to design changes, ECO/ECM processes and component end-of-life (EOL) management.

**About The Role And Key Responsibilities

**Your primary responsibilities:

• Ensure the effective transfer of products from development to production, including NPI, documentation and release to production

• Contribute to the manufacture, assembly and testing of prototypes in close collaboration with development, production and suppliers

• Plan and coordinate testing, validation and verification activities, and prepare and maintain test procedures for printed circuit boards, products and subsystems

• Maintain PCB documentation, design documentation, bills of materials, product data and production processes in connection with development, handover and production maturation

• Support production with technical assistance, troubleshooting, root cause analyses and continuous improvements

• Lead and contribute to ECO and ECM processes, and manage design changes and component end-of-life (EOL) in collaboration with PCB suppliers and product specialists

• Work closely with subcontractors and PCB suppliers to support prototype development, production, testing, documentation and product improvements

• Contribute to compliance, traceability and regulatory requirements while developing and maintaining high-quality technical documentation, including manuals, instructions and technical training materials

**Your profile

**We expect that you:

• Hold an engineering degree or an equivalent technical qualification

• Have experience in product development, production engineering, Product Engineering or NPI processes

• Have hands-on experience with prototypes, testing, validation and technical troubleshooting

• Have experience with electronics. Experience with printed circuit boards, mechanics or mechatronics is considered an advantage

• Thrive at the intersection of hardware, software, production and supplier collaboration, working closely with developers, production teams, product specialists, service functions and external suppliers

• Work systematically with documentation, quality, test procedures and process improvements

• Communicate effectively in both Danish and English.

**Additional Information

**We offer:

• A central role in a strong professional environment with a high level of responsibility

• Flexibility, development opportunities, and access to highly specialized expertise

• A workplace focused on quality, innovation, and future-proof solutions

• An informal and collaborative culture that values initiative and professional curiosity

At Force Technology, you work alongside specialists who are deeply committed to their fields and proud of the value their expertise creates. Many choose to build their careers here because they enjoy exploring their field in depth and pushing the boundaries of their expertise.

The opportunity to specialise does not mean doing the same thing every day. Customer challenges, new technologies and cross-disciplinary collaboration create opportunities for continuous learning.

Despite the high level of expertise, the culture is informal and approachable. Colleagues take an interest in each other, share their knowledge generously and are always willing to help.

**Does this sound like something for you?

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Troels Balmer Christensen on trch@forcetechnology.com.

We look forward to receiving your application, CV and other relevant attachments.

At Force Technology, we are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment, and we are actively looking for qualified people candidates regardless of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, disability or age.

**Force Technology

**At Force Technology, we help businesses and society navigate technological opportunities and challenges safely.

As one of Denmark's largest GTS institutes, we play a unique role in strengthening innovation, competitiveness and technological resilience. As an independent expert authority and technology advisor, we help ensure that technology creates value for people, businesses and society.

When you join us, you become part of an expert environment with more than 1,000 specialists across 18 offices in 4 countries working together to turn knowledge into sustainable solutions.

Imagine working on Denmark's most critical systems, turning unique customer data into real value through applied machine learning. As our new Data Scientist, you will play a key role in analysing customer data and training models within our established product. Ready to make an impact?

The job

You will be responsible for generating value from customer data within our established product, which underpins national security and critical infrastructure domains. Our customers are classified and cannot be disclosed, so your work will take place in secure environments, often in collaboration with Product teams, security teams and onsite at customer locations. As this is a newly established position, you will have the opportunity to help shape this role as it grows.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Analysing and preparing customer data for use in our established product

• Training, evaluating and refining machine learning models on customer data

• Integrating models and data-driven features that generate measurable value

• Exploring customer data to identify new opportunities for value creation

• Collaborating with security teams to ensure compliance with national classifications and profiles

Joining the team

You will join an organisation where you will be associated with multiple teams, part of our NSI business unit. We develop and maintain military-grade solutions that support a nation's most critical systems. The organisation is highly collaborative, organised around Products that make a difference.

If you are located in Aarhus, we are open to discussing a hybrid arrangement, but you should expect regular presence in Copenhagen (6–8 days per month).

Your qualifications

We are looking for a data scientist with hands-on experience applying machine learning to real-world data in production settings, who can work confidently in high-stakes, security-classified environments.

• Relevant technical education, Bachelor's or Master's, in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or equivalent experience

• Documented experience with applied machine learning on real-world data

• Some hands-on experience with data science and machine learning in production settings

• Strong knowledge of Python, machine learning frameworks (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow), SQL and data processing tools

• Fluent Danish and English skills

• A strong security mindset and ability to work in high-stakes environments

Alongside this, we value:

• A collaborative and proactive work style

• Comfortable working independently and navigating ambiguity, particularly as this is a newly established role

• Comfortable working onsite at customer environments when needed

Expect travel activity to our HQ in Aarhus and to customer sites, primarily in Copenhagen.

**Software Architect:

Agentic AI & Java, SitaWare Insight

**_Are you passionate about building sophisticated AI agents that solve real world problems? Join our Agentic AI team within SitaWare Insight, designing multi-agent workflows in Java and Python that power critical decision-making and help our customers get the job done faster and safer.

_**The job

**As Software Architect on this team, you will combine deep software architecture expertise in Java with strong LLM and AI engineering fundamentals to shape the technical foundation of our AI-driven solutions. You will define the technical vision and architectural strategy that enable our product, AI agents and multi-agent systems to scale, while also designing and implementing the software solutions that bring this vision to life.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Converting customer needs into robust software architectures for AI agents, multi-agent orchestration and RAG pipelines

• Designing and implementing AI agents, including tool definitions, action groups and knowledge base integrations

• Ensuring safe and predictable outcomes through human-in-the-loop design and guardrails, and building traceability and transparency into our AI-based solutions

• Writing production-grade Java code with full test coverage, structured logging and robust error handling

• Establishing and maintaining technology standards, and evaluating new technologies as they emerge

**Joining the team

**You will join a growing team within the SitaWare Insight program, close to 50 engineers, architects and testers across five Scrum teams, spanning Aarhus and Copenhagen. We are building a brand-new team around this role:

an architect, a data scientist, five to seven developers and a tester, working closely with our Product Manager and UX designer. Java is our primary backend language, and we also work in Python for our AI tooling, and we collaborate with researchers to give our LLMs geospatial situational awareness, the ability to understand tactical maps and follow events across an evolving timeline. If you enjoy figuring out how to make new AI capabilities work safely and reliably in a domain where the stakes are real, you will feel at home here.

**Your Qualifications

**

• 8+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience in a software architecture role, designing and specifying system structures, interfaces and dependencies

• Strong backend development experience in Java, and familiarity with frontend architectures such as Angular or similar

• Strong understanding of microservices architecture, message queues and system integration patterns

• Experience with Docker and Kubernetes, and a solid grasp of how these fit into system architecture and deployment strategy

• A proven track record of defining technical vision and architectural strategy that supports product scalability and evolution

• Solid software engineering practices, including testing, logging, observability and version control, along with the ability to establish technology standards across a team

For more senior profiles, we are also looking for:

• At least two to three years focused on LLM or AI systems, including architecting and overseeing the deployment of AI-powered applications in Java and Python

• Deep understanding of orchestration frameworks, RAG architectures, vector databases, embedding models, hybrid search and tool-use/function-calling patterns

• Experience designing multi-agent systems, including orchestration patterns such as routing, delegation, parallelisation and result aggregation

• Familiarity with LLM evaluation frameworks and metrics, such as relevance, faithfulness and hallucination detection, and how to build evaluation and observability into system architecture

You should expect around two to four weeks of travel per year, giving you the chance to collaborate across our Aarhus and Copenhagen teams.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**About The Role

**Genmab is seeking a Project Manager CMC Product Lifecycle Management to

• join the CMC Life Cycle Management (LCM) Team and support our growing portfolio of commercial products globally.

The LCM team is responsible for managing the CMC lifecycle activities of Genmab’s commercial products and manufacturing oversight, ensuring supply continuity, regulatory compliance, and successful execution of post-approval activities throughout the product lifecycle. In this role, you’ll work closely with LCM Product Lead and colleagues across Commercial Supply Chain, MSAT, Regulatory CMC, Commercial QA and External Manufacturing to ensure seamless execution of lifecycle management activities.

The CMC Life Cycle Management Team is part of CMC Project & Portfolio Management (PPM) which also includes the Early-Stage Development, Late-stage Development and External Manufacturing teams. CMC Project & Portfolio Management resides within CMC Development and Manufacturing, based in Denmark.

This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the continued growth of Genmab's commercial portfolio while working in a highly collaborative and cross-functional environment at the interface of development, manufacturing, supply, and regulatory affairs.

**Responsibilities

**

• Work alongside the LCM Lead to provide manufacturing oversight and execute lifecycle activities for an assigned manufacturing track (DS, BI, CI or DP) after commercial launch, supporting batch release and reliable supply. The LCM Lead retains overall product accountability.

• Lead operational governance with internal functions and partners/CMOs, aligning priorities, preparing decisions, tracking progress and actions, and providing input on CMO performance.

• Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders on daily operations to ensure manufacturing oversight (ie. Deviation management, change control, complaint handling, etc) , support batch release and supply, issues resolution/escalation and quality/regulatory compliance.

• Coordinate technical issue resolution and manage track risks with relevant experts, ensuring required assessments, documentation and mitigation actions, and escalating issues with proposed next steps.

• Drive manufacturing changes, projects and improvements within agreed scope, timelines and budgets.

• Support implementation of CMC commitments and Post-approval change management related to assigned product manufacturing track (i.e DS, BI, CI, DP) and support coordination of submission documentation preparation across stakeholders and CMOs/Partners.

• Support initiatives to optimize yield, reduce cost of goods, and enhance robustness of manufacturing and testing processes

• Help establish and improve LCM processes, governance, tools and ways of working, incorporating lessons learned.

**Requirements

**

• Master's degree in science or related technical discipline (e.g. engineering, biotech, pharmaceutical, biochemistry, biology) or equivalent experience;

• 4+ years of experience in biopharmaceutical industry, preferably within manufacturing operations, lifecycle, product management for commercial products.

• Experience in building relations and influencing multi-functional teams within multicultural organizations.

• Proven track record in CMC project management, manufacturing operations management or product management across development and commercialization activities.

• Experience managing and defining project coordination activities and tasks in a structured, regulated environment.

• Prior experience with commercial product lifecycle management and oversight of Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) is considered an advantage.

• Broad understanding of global cGMP requirements and regulatory expectations across major markets

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with fluency in English

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional and multicultural environments

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, balance competing demands, and deliver against project timelines

• Team player with the ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.

• Result- and goal-oriented, committed to contributing to Genmab’s success

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK597.312,00---895.968,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Are you our new Data Scientist – Panels & Survey Methodology?

AudienceProject is looking for a Data Scientist – Panels & Survey Methodology for our Copenhagen office to support our continued growth.

—

Are you a quantitative researcher who enjoys working with data about people? And are you interested in how panels and surveys can make audience measurement more reliable? Then, we have an opportunity for a career in a fast-growing scale-up with 100+ employees that collaborates directly with companies such as Heineken, L’Oréal, LVMH, Omnicom Media, Publicis Media, WPP Media, Amazon, Google, Netflix, RTL and Warner Bros. Discovery.

AudienceProject is a leader in independent cross-media measurement, enabling advertisers, media owners and the industry to trust, prove, and improve advertising outcomes through a scalable SaaS platform.

Our platform provides advertisers with a unified view of campaign performance, enabling confident omnichannel investment decisions, and provides media owners with comparable, third-party validation to demonstrate the value of their inventory.

After more than 15 years of leading cross-media measurement, we are now looking for a motivated Data Scientist – Panels & Survey Methodology to join our Data Science Research team.

Joining AudienceProject will give you a front-row seat in the rapidly evolving advertising industry and an opportunity to work within a respected business, delivering insights about audiences across the world's largest media channels to top-tier clients.

What you will do

You will join our Data Science Research pod, led by Jacob Daniel Kirstejn Hansen, and help turn panel and survey data into reliable audience measurement. Our panelists are recruited through several panel partners. They contribute passive measurement data through integrations and take part in surveys that help calibrate our models. You will work with 10 other data scientists and engineers, bringing together a range of academic and professional backgrounds.

Your focus will be quantitative analysis, panel quality and statistical methodology. You will use Python to investigate data and develop reproducible analyses, working closely with researchers and engineers to improve the inputs and methods behind our measurement.

We actively explore and apply AI in our internal work, production systems and products, combining experimentation with sound analytical judgement. You will help evaluate promising approaches with data scientists and developers and turn useful ideas into practical improvements.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Analyse panel composition and coverage across partners, identifying differences, gaps and potential sources of bias.

• Assess the completeness, consistency and plausibility of passive measurement data, and investigate unexpected changes.

• Design and analyse surveys that describe panelists and their behaviour and provide data for model calibration.

• Contribute to the development and evaluation of weighting, calibration, and statistical modelling approaches, testing how methodological choices affect audience estimates.

• Identify survey-response quality issues and assess the trade-off between stricter quality rules and retaining a representative sample.

• Clean, combine, and analyse panel and survey datasets in Python, with clear documentation of assumptions, methods and limitations.

• Work with panel-partner colleagues, data scientists, and engineers to turn findings into practical data-quality improvements and evaluate their effect.

Who you are

You combine strong quantitative skills with curiosity about how people are represented in data. You enjoy tracing an unexpected result back to its source, questioning assumptions and explaining what the evidence supports. Your background may be in statistics, quantitative social science, economics, psychology, data science or another relevant field.

You bring:

• Strong skills in quantitative analysis and applied statistics, including regression, sampling, uncertainty and model validation.

• Hands-on Python skills to clean, explore and analyse real-world data independently and make your work reproducible.

• An understanding of panels and surveys, including representativeness, selection bias, non-response and measurement error.

• A careful approach to data quality and the ability to judge how data issues affect an analysis or model.

• The ability to explain methods and findings clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

• A relevant quantitative education or equivalent applied research experience.

Useful additional experience includes weighting, calibration or passive behavioural data.

We value thoughtful analysis, openness to different perspectives and colleagues who share what they learn. You ask questions, test assumptions and explain your conclusions clearly.

What we offer

You will join a curious, collaborative and energetic environment where data scientists and developers share ideas and learn from one another. Different perspectives help us ask better questions and improve how we measure audiences.

Our social calendar offers plenty of opportunities to get to know colleagues, with activities you can choose to join. There is room to contribute your ideas, take on meaningful research questions and develop your skills with the support of colleagues.

• Competitive salary

• Pension scheme and health insurance

• Home internet paid

• Central Copenhagen office

• International environment

• Friendly, supportive and helpful colleagues

• Innovative and market-leading products and services

• Real-world panel and survey data, with research questions about quality, representativeness and uncertainty

• The opportunity to improve the statistical methods behind independent audience measurement

• Working directly with some of the most modern and successful companies of our time

Send us your application

We welcome different routes into data science. If this role interests you and you bring relevant quantitative and Python skills, we would like to hear from you.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Jacob Daniel Kirstejn Hansen at jacobh@audienceproject.com. Attention: applications and documents sent via email will not be considered.

We are only considering candidates who are already based in Copenhagen, as we are unable to offer relocation support for this position.

We will be inviting candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so please don’t hesitate to send your application sooner rather than later.

You can only apply once to this position via Linkedin, so make sure you attach the following information into one document:

• CV

• Cover letter

The deadline for applications is the 6th of November, 2026.

We look forward to receiving your application!

**The Impact You'll Make

**As our Communication Coordinator, you’ll help bring our Digital and Lifecycle Services portfolio to life for colleagues, partners, customers, and end users around the world.

You’ll join the Digital & Lifecycle Services Communications team and contribute to strengthening the visibility of our service business through engaging visual communication, content, marketing materials, and events. Working across an international organization, you’ll have the opportunity to turn complex topics into clear and compelling communication.

This fixed-term role is available for one year and offers the opportunity to build hands-on experience across graphic design, communication, and service product launches in a global environment while contributing to solutions that support energy efficiency throughout the product lifecycle.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Work together with the Communication Manager to support daily internal and external communication activities, build content for thought leadership topics, and help with creation of focus business marketing narratives.

• Create engaging visual communication, including icons, visual concepts, posters, images, and other branded materials using Adobe tools.

• Develop content supporting marketing and communication activities across Digital & Lifecycle Services.

• Collaborate with global marketing teams to create and launch marketing materials such as sales presentations, fact sheets, product descriptions, and other communication assets.

• Contribute to our Service Partner Program, developing branded materials such as presentations, guides, fact sheets, visuals, and other supporting content.

**What We're Looking For

**We’re looking for someone who combines creativity with a structured approach and enjoys turning ideas into communication that is easy to understand and visually engaging.

**To Be Successful In This Role, You Bring

**

• Experience with graphic design, content creation, communication, or marketing and familiarity with design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign, video editing skillset, or similar.

• A structured, hands-on approach and the ability to coordinate tasks and projects involving different stakeholders

SENIOR MECHANICAL PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER

Join our product development team

Mechanical Product Development • Robust Design • Plastics • From Design To Production-ready Product

Location: Allerød, north of Copenhagen • Function: R&D / Product Development

Do you enjoy the engineering disciplines that turn a good mechanical design into a robust product design that works reliably in the real world?

Qufora is a growing, design-focused medical device company. We develop intuitive products that help people with chronic bowel disorders live a more fulfilled life.

We have a relatively small and flat organisation, which means short distances from idea to decision and from decision to action. You will be close to the products, the technical decisions and the people who make them—with the opportunity to influence both the engineering solutions and how we work.

The engineering role

This is a role for someone who enjoys the fundamentals of good mechanical engineering and knows how to combine them into robust design solutions. Understanding variation and sensitivity to design products that perform consistently despite real-world variation in components, materials, processes and use.

• Interface & mechanical design – create well-defined interfaces and mechanically sound solutions without unnecessary constraints or complexity.

• Tolerances & GPS/GD&T – translate functional needs into meaningful dimensions and tolerances, using tolerance stack-ups and statistical tolerancing where relevant.

• Mechanics & structural integrity – apply solid mechanics, engineering calculations and FEA where appropriate to understand loads, deformation, strength, fatigue and failure modes.

• Materials & plastics – select materials based on function, environment, manufacturing process and long-term product performance.

• DFM/DFA & injection moulding – develop designs that can be manufactured and assembled consistently and at the required quality, working closely with toolmakers, suppliers and Operations.

• Variation & statistical analysis – use data and statistical methods to understand variation, identify critical parameters and build robustness into the design.

You will not be placed in a narrow technical box. Depending on the challenge, you may move from CAD and tolerance analysis to material selection, supplier discussions, FEA, design reviews, verification results or solving a difficult mechanical problem in an existing product.

What you will do

You will take senior technical ownership of mechanical development activities, particularly in the later stages of product development.

You will:

• Develop and mature mechanical solutions from established concepts through detailed design, verification, design transfer and launch.

• Create high-quality 3D designs and clear, production-ready 2D drawings.

• Drive difficult mechanical issues to root cause and closure.

• Work hands-on with plastics, injection-moulded components, interfaces, tolerances, materials and robust design.

• Work closely with Operations, external manufacturers, suppliers and toolmakers to turn designs into stable, manufacturable products.

• Lead and coordinate mechanical engineering activities when several people or disciplines need to contribute.

• Help strengthen our mechanical engineering methods, standards and ways of working.

What we are looking for

You have a BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Product Development or a similar discipline and at least 8 years of experience in mechanical product development.

Ideally, you bring several of the following:

• Strong mechanical design fundamentals and engineering judgement.

• Experience with plastic product design and injection moulding.

• Advanced 3D CAD and 2D drawing skills, preferably SolidWorks.

• Strong knowledge of ISO GPS/GD&T, tolerance analysis and robust design.

• Experience with DFM/DFA, materials, mechanics and preferably FEA.

• Experience taking products from detailed development through verification and into production.

• The ability to structure complex technical work and drive issues to completion.

Experience from medical devices or another regulated industry is an advantage, but first and foremost, we are looking for a strong mechanical product developer.

Why Qufora?

At Qufora, you will work broadly across mechanical engineering disciplines and follow products through the development process rather than being limited to one narrow area. You will be close to the products, colleagues and decisions, with the opportunity to influence both engineering solutions and how we work. And because we develop medical devices, your engineering decisions ultimately matter to people who rely on our products every day.

Application

Please apply through LinkedIn. Applications will be reviewed, and interviews held on an ongoing basis.

As Group Category Manager – Logistics, you will report to the CPO and lead the development and execution of the Group Logistics procurement strategy across road freight including line-haul and last mile distribution, ocean freight, warehousing and related logistics services including pallets. You will combine strategic category leadership with hands-on execution, working closely with local market organisations,

The role will be based at our HQ in Faxe, Denmark.

**Main Responsibilities

**Strategy Development:

• Define and execute a multi-year procurement category strategy for Logistics that balances local execution with strategic priorities to support the group’s overarching goals.

• Leverage a strong external radar and category expertise to identify, evaluate and act on emerging opportunities and risks, i.e. external supplier landscape, commodities, industry best practices, digitalisation and automation and EU legislative environment.

**Category And Supplier Relationship Management

**

• Optimise category management processes, elevate sourcing and contract management processes, and build best practices with the market teams and stakeholders. Increase utilisation of eSourcing and development of digital tools to support cost modelling, benchmarking, and contract management.

• Develop supplier collaboration platforms with key suppliers across the group to unlock operational efficiencies, process enhancements, digital innovation, and to accelerate sustainability and circularity initiatives.

**Value Delivery, Efficiency And Business Partnering

**

• Deliver cost savings, supply chain efficiencies and carbon reduction targets. Establish ways of working with stakeholders to measure relevant KPIs, track initiatives, manage risk and deliver multiyear productivity plans.

• Ensure early engagement and alignment with relevant stakeholders on business strategy to maintain a fit for purpose and efficient logistics network driving optimal cost to serve to fuel sustainable business growth.

• Provide category leadership and inputs into on strategic projects, integration, and network optimisation.

• Streamline processes and drive digitalisation agenda.

**Ideal Candidate

**

• Bachelor’s degree. Professional CIPS qualification or similar will be considered.

• Min. 8 years of relevant procurement experience in logistics categories in an international or matrixed organisation. Nordics and CPG industry experience is a plus.

• Comprehensive knowledge of procurement processes, ERP systems, procurement tools and network modelling, including a strong data analytics skillset and commodity management experience.

• Excellent communication, gravitas and influencing skills to build relationships with senior stakeholders internally and externally.

• Team player with a service-oriented mindset but is also not afraid to challenge the status quo or be the critical friend when required.

• Project and change management - track record for initiating and embedding change.

• Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands on execution.

• Energised by challenges, white spaces, and complexity.

• Enthusiastic, solution-oriented approach.

• Passion for developing and coaching teams.

**What Success Looks Like

**Success in this role means creating a Logistics procurement organisation that is recognised as a strategic business partner, delivering measurable value beyond price reduction.

The successful candidate will establish strong Group category governance while enabling local ownership, build strategic supplier partnerships, increase data and digital maturity, strengthen resilience and sustainability, and continuously identify opportunities to improve the total cost, service and efficiency of Royal Unibrew's logistics network.

At Royal Unibrew, you'll find the industry's most dedicated, energetic, and experienced colleagues. Together, we build the best framework for a job that precisely matches your everyday life and career aspirations.

Royal Unibrew produces, markets, sells, and distributes quality beverages. We are a consortium of more than 35 breweries and beverage producers from across Denmark, known especially for our traditional, locally-rooted brands such as Faxe Kondi, Egekilde, Royal Beer, Ceres, and Odense Pilsner, as well as partner brands like Pepsi MAX and Heineken.

Today, we are the second-largest beverage company in Denmark. Our journey began in 1856, and we still maintain a strong commercial focus, a clear growth strategy, and an ambitious sustainability strategy - both domestically and internationally.

You'll have over 1500 colleagues in Denmark and more than 2700 colleagues outside the country, including in Finland, Italy, France, Norway, Canada, the Netherlands, and the Baltic countries.

With us, you'll be part of challenging the boundaries of sustainable production and distribution. You'll help ensure a diverse range of beverages that bring people together - on the dance floor, during the third half, or over a meal - all while contributing to strengthening Danish sports, music, and community life.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager, EndoIntelligence Solutions, Global R&D
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Project Manager with a background in medical device development? Do you enjoy leading complex development projects and coordinating work across internal teams and external development partners? Then you may be the Project Manager we are looking for in EndoIntelligence Solutions within Global R&D.

In this role, you will lead a strategically important development project and work closely with a global and cross-functional team to ensure successful project execution from planning through delivery.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of in-person collaboration and focused individual work. That's why this role is based in Augsburg or Ballerup and follows a hybrid working model, with three days per week in the office and two days working from home.

**Key Responsibilities

**As Project Manager, you will:

• Lead a cross-functional development project through all phases of the product development process.

• Drive project planning, execution, follow-up, and reporting of scope, timeline, budget, risks, and key decisions.

• Coordinate activities across engineering disciplines and key stakeholders.

• Manage and maintain strong collaboration with external development partners and suppliers.

• Facilitate project governance activities, including Steering Committee reviews and decision-making forums.

• Ensure project documentation and deliverables are completed in accordance with Ambu's quality system and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Create transparency, alignment, and engagement across the project team and stakeholder landscape.

• Support the continuous improvement of project management practices and lessons learned.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experience can be gained in many ways, and we understand that the perfect candidate cannot be defined on paper. However, you are likely to succeed in this role if you:

• Hold a technical degree within engineering or a related field.

• Have experience leading the development of complex medical device hardware, including electronics, mechanics, embedded systems, and integration across disciplines.

• Have worked closely with external development partners and suppliers and understand how to manage outsourced development activities, technical deliverables, timelines, and risks.

• Have experience working with internal and external development teams across different regions, including Asian and European countries, and bring the cultural awareness needed to adapt ways of working and build effective collaboration across cultures.

• Are comfortable navigating a complex stakeholder environment and driving alignment across functions.

• Bring a structured and proactive approach to project execution and risk management.

• Have strong communication and leadership skills and enjoy working with international teams.

• Are fluent in written and spoken English.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**At Ambu, you will become part of an international organization with ambitious growth plans and a strong innovation agenda. We work in cross-functional teams and value collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement. You will have the opportunity to contribute to innovative healthcare solutions while developing your professional and personal capabilities in a dynamic environment.

Apply directly through our job portal. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for a Marketing Manager for a maternity cover of approximately 13 months to drive the customer-facing journey and category performance across our Kids department. From everyday essentials to seasonal collections, footwear and accessories, you will bring the category to life through engaging campaigns, inspiring content and a seamless shopping experience across our channels.

This is your chance to join a passionate, fast-paced team where creativity meets commercial strategy, and where your work makes a real impact on how customers discover and shop Kids at Boozt.

**What You Will Do

**As our Marketing Manager for the kids category, you will play a key role in planning and executing marketing activities across onsite, CRM and campaign touchpoints, ensuring that the category stays relevant, engaging and commercially strong.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• 
Develop and execute quarterly and yearly Kids marketing plans, aligned with commercial priorities and seasonal initiatives.

• 
Own the Kids front page and key landing pages, ensuring a strong and engaging digital shopping experience.

• 
Monitor traffic, engagement and category KPIs, using performance insights to evaluate results and optimize activities.

• 
Collaborate with CRM to develop engaging, high-performing email campaigns that support category priorities.

•

**YOUR PROFILE

**We are looking for someone who combines a creative mindset with a strong commercial understanding and knows how to turn customer insights and category trends into engaging marketing activities.

**We Imagine That You Bring

**

• 
At least 3 years of e-commerce marketing experience, preferably within fashion, kidswear or retail

• 
Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple activities and deadlines

• 
A collaborative mindset and experience working across creative, commercial and technical teams

• 
Strong analytical skills and experience using tools such as Google Analytics and Qlik Sense

• 
An understanding of customer behaviour, seasonal trends and what drives performance in an online retail environment

Fluency in English, our company language

**WHY BOOZT?

And who knows where your Boozt journey might take you next?

**Apply today – we’re excited to learn more about you!

**_Only applications submitted in English will be considered.

**

Great personal and internal career development opportunities

• 
A culture built on our values of trust, freedom, and responsibility

Driven and passionate international colleagues

A generous employee discount

In-house gym, onsite masseuse, and medical doctor

jobs.occupation: New Product Planning & Forecasting Associate Director
jobs.description:
**Your impact begins here

**As New Product Planning & Forecasting Associate Director, you will bring a strong commercial perspective and shape the long-term forecasts that guide brand, portfolio and corporate decisions within Blood & Endocrine (formerly Rare Disease). Your recommendations will help senior leaders decide where to invest, so promising science reaches more patients living with rare, serious chronic diseases. Your work starts influencing real decisions from day one.

**What You’ll Bring

**We are looking for someone who combines scientific understanding and commercial insight with rigorous analysis and can turn complexity into clear recommendations. You bring:

• A Master’s or PhD in business, economics, medicine, biology or pharmacy.

• 8–10 years of relevant experience in the pharmaceutical industry or similar experience from a top management consultancy.

• Experience developing global and local forecasts integrating epidemiological, market, clinical, and competitive assumptions.

• Experience working across the pharma value chain (e.g., clinical development, market access, commercial) to assess an early-stage assets’ clinical and commercial value.

• Strong commercial understanding and a solid grounding in natural science.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to build clear frameworks from limited data.

• Strong understanding of financial valuation methodologies and value drivers for pharmaceutical assets.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Direct experience in forecasting, new product planning, and asset valuations.

• Experience working with Rare Disease, especially in endocrine, musculoskeletal, and/or renal diseases.

**What You’ll Do

**You will play a leading role across two connected areas: New Product Planning and Forecasting. Working across assigned assets and therapy areas, you will turn complex clinical, market and competitive insights into clear recommendations that guide development and investment decisions.

**You Will

**

• Own New Product Planning & Forecasting wholistically for one or two therapeutic areas within the Blood & Endocrine

• Drive Target Product Profile development for early-stage assets working in close collaboration with the Global Project Teams.

• Lead project valuations and risk assessments for pipeline assets at critical gate passages

• Own the long-term forecast process and outcome, challenging local market assumptions and deliver realistic and ambitious forecasts.

• Develop scenarios that reveal the key value drivers, opportunities and risks, and translate them into clear actions for brands and senior management.

• Provide robust, fact-based decision support to Global Project Teams and senior leaders, ensuring alignment between commercial, clinical and regulatory strategies.

**Who You’ll Work With

**In Product & Portfolio Strategy, colleagues connect commercial strategy, medical affairs and business development across therapy areas, helping guide the Novo portfolio and strengthen competitiveness. You will join the New Product Planning & Forecasting team within Commercial Excellence & Strategic Planning in Blood & Endocrine, reporting to the Director of NPP & Forecasting.

Your work is global in reach. You will partner closely with multiple teams across the organization, both at local and regional level – as well as with external vendors and consultants. Bringing these perspectives together, you will create clarity, secure buy-in and help decisions move at pace.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will work in a high-trust environment with a high level of independence and empowerment to make decisions on your daily work. The role offers cross value chain exposure across commercial, medical, research and supply, and the chance to influence choices that shape the future of the portfolio. You will be trusted to raise the bar, mentor others and grow your commercial and analytical expertise.

**_Salary

_**For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 847,000.00 to 1,245,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate's skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

**Incentives And Benefits

**The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn analysis into decisions that shape a portfolio and progress for people living with rare, serious chronic diseases, apply for the New Product Planning & Forecasting Associate Director role by November 6th, 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: HR Business Partner, Strategic Marketing and International Sales
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced HR Business Partner who thrives in a dynamic international environment? Do you enjoy partnering with senior leaders, translating business priorities into people strategies, and driving organisational effectiveness through strong HR partnering? And are you motivated by supporting commercial organisations where leadership, talent and culture play a critical role in business success? Then you might be our new HR Business Partner for Strategic Marketing and International Sales at Demant Diagnostics.

Driving people and business success across Strategic Marketing and International Sales

As HR Business Partner for Strategic Marketing and International Sales, you will act as a trusted advisor to leaders and leadership teams, helping translate strategy into practical people and organisational solutions. You will support two business functions, each led by its own Vice President and operating with different priorities, organisational structures and ways of working.

In this role, you will partner closely with leaders to strengthen organisational effectiveness, leadership capability, employee engagement and business performance. You will be responsible for ensuring that people priorities are closely aligned with business goals while supporting the execution of the broader Diagnostics and global Demant people agenda.

Meet your new team and manager

The Diagnostics HR team acts as a close partner to leaders and the organisation, enabling strong performance, development and engagement across our global Diagnostics business. We work at the intersection of people, business and organisational development, ensuring that HR initiatives create value for both leaders and employees.

Our team values trust, development and continuous improvement. We combine strategic HR partnering with pragmatic execution and take pride in delivering professional, high-quality support across a diverse and international organisation.

The position is reporting to Kirsten Schmidt, Senior Director Diagnostics HR, and is based at the Demant Diagnostics Headquarters in Smørum, Copenhagen. We offer flexibility to work from home when business needs and tasks allow.

Global HR partnering supporting a growing business area

The HR Business Partner will play a key role in supporting leaders through organisational changes, helping navigate complexity, manage stakeholder expectations and create sustainable business solutions.

You will collaborate with HR colleagues and business stakeholders across functions, countries and organisational levels to ensure consistent and effective implementation of HR initiatives.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Partner closely with the Vice Presidents and leadership teams within Strategic Marketing and International Sales

• Act as a trusted advisor and sparring partner on leadership, organisational and people-related matters

• Coach and challenge leaders to strengthen leadership effectiveness and team performance

• Drive and support organisational development, capability building and change initiatives

• Drive and facilitate initiatives to ensure alignment between business priorities and global HR processes.

• Lead talent and succession discussions, supporting the identification, development and retention of key capabilities

• Use people insights and workforce data to support informed decision-making and organisational planning

In addition, you will support organisational reviews, workforce planning and employee engagement initiatives while contributing to a positive, inclusive and high-performing culture.

**Your qualifications & experience

**

We imagine that you will bring a combination of:

• Solid experience as an HR Business Partner supporting leaders and commercial organisations in a complex business environment

• Relevant degree within human resources, business administration, organisational psychology or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

• Proven experience advising and influencing leaders on organisational, talent and people matters

• Experience driving organisational change, leadership development and talent management initiatives

• Strong understanding of core HR disciplines and employment practices

• Experience working in an international and matrix-based organisation

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken

• Experience supporting senior leaders or executives

Bringing solid business acumen, sound judgement and a collaborative approach to all your stakeholders will provide you with a great foundation for this role. Furthermore, you are comfortable balancing strategic priorities with operational execution and have the confidence to challenge constructively while building trusted relationships across the organisation.

Why join us?

This is an opportunity to join a global organisation where people, leadership and business performance are closely connected. You will work with experienced leaders, influence strategic people agendas and contribute to shaping the future organisation across Strategic Marketing and International Sales.

Ready to join Demant Diagnostic’s HR team?

Then send your application and CV in English as soon as possible but no later than 8th of November. Please note we only accept application via our application system.

1st interviews will be conducted on the 17th of November

We aim to conduct 2nd interviews on the 24th of November

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

About Demant Diagnostics

Demant’s diagnostics business is a trusted diagnostic solutions provider in the field of hearing and balance assessment. This group of international companies develops, manufactures, and markets a wide variety of technological solutions globally, delivering instruments, software, training, and services that support the entire diagnostic journey – from early screening to advanced clinical assessment and balance treatment. Our portfolio includes well-known brands such as Maico, Interacoustics, Amplivox, GSI Grason-Stadler, MedRx, Audioscan, and Inventis.

Our products are sold in more than 100 countries through an extensive network of sales companies and distributors.

For more information, please visit: www.demant.com.
